name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-giant-exclamation-mark-blocks
title: Super Mario World - Giant Exclamation Mark Blocks
description:
This simple block graphics are the exclamation mark blocks from Super Mario World but doubled in size.

Note that if you want them to be functional, please download these custom blocks and set the giant blocks in such a way that (there are example blocks which recreate the normal !-blocks in this pack).
And if you want them to be dependent on the currently activated switches, you want to use this patch. I also have included an instruction on how to insert them.
